1.$description: series 1 — indigo. most distinct pair anchors the ramp

5.$description: series 5 — blue-gray. min ΔE 35.5 to any earlier series — the comfortable ceiling

6.$description: series 6 — blue. min ΔE 24.3 — acceptable only if not adjacent to series 1

7.$description: series 7 — purple. min ΔE 16.1 to purple's neighbour; past this, aggregate rather than add a colour

1.$description: sequential 1 — the low end. L* 93.6. One hue family, lightness falling at every step (ADR-0096): a magnitude, not a deviation from a midpoint

5.$description: sequential 5 — the high end. L* 34.4. Measured: adjacent ΔE ≥ 20.0 in normal, protan, deutan and tritan vision; red→yellow→green kept 18.9 end to end in protan

threshold.$description: a threshold or reference line drawn dashed across a plot (ADR-0096) — 4.8:1 on white, readable on the dark ground too

land.$description: decorative — the ground that holds a map's place until its basemap arrives (ADR-0122): the TOLBI style's own land, so the basemap fades in over its own colour

pending.$description: decorative — the dashed outline of a parcel whose data has not arrived yet (ADR-0122), for the engine's paint (mapPending in ./tokens/js); 4.16:1 on map-land, past the 3:1 a non-text mark needs
